title: Replicating multi-concept steering composition on a new model and new safety concept pair

original_idea.body: Extract two safety concept vectors, add them simultaneously at varying coefficients on a new model, measure whether joint steering achieves both behaviors, and quantify interference.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: interference in multi-concept safety steering affects deployments, but replication with a gap.

novelty.reasoning: Composition shown; new pair/model replication may be partly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Safety-pair interference replication may be partly open.
